name: list_cves
description: List and count tracked CVEs, optionally filtered by ecosystem, package, severity, or fix status.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem, e.g. npm, PyPI, Go.

has_fix.description: Whether a fix is available: pass true or false.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

min_severity.description: Minimum severity: critical, high, medium, or low.

modified_after.description: ISO-8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z (a bare date is rejected); only CVEs modified on/after it.

published_after.description: ISO-8601 datetime, e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z (a bare date is rejected); only CVEs published on/after it.

q.description: Plain case-insensitive substring search over CVE id, summary, and details. Not a dork — use the typed filters for precise matches.

name: list_endpoints
description: List and count crawled sitemap endpoints, optionally filtered by path, content type, HTTP methods, or status family. Use q for dork search (see the q field for keys).

has_query.description: Filter to endpoints whose URL has a query string (true/false).

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

methods.description: Comma-separated HTTP methods to include, e.g. GET,POST.

q.description: Dork/free-text search. Keys: host,origin,program,path,url,content_type,method,scheme,port,status,length,has_query,root,seen. Syntax: bare words = free text; key:value filters; multiple terms AND; quote values with spaces (no negation/wildcard operators). Example: path:/admin status:200.

name: list_hunter_capabilities
description: List the exact Hunter MCP capabilities currently enabled for this Assistant turn, with safe authority metadata and effective workflow limits.

name: list_jobs
description: List and count Control Center Whiterabbit job runs, optionally filtered by status.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

status.description: Filter by job status: queued, running, succeeded, failed, or pending.

name: list_new_cves
description: List newly first-seen CVEs from a bounded cursor.

name: list_playbooks
description: List and count Control Center Ansible playbooks, ordered by name. Page with page/limit.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

name: list_program_changes
description: List the configured administrator's recent program changes.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

name: list_programs
description: List and count bug-bounty programs, optionally filtered by status, bounty, collaboration, scope size, report volume, platform, or scope type. Use q for dork search (see the q field for keys).

bounty.description: Filter by bounty presence: with or without.

collaboration.description: Filter by collaboration: yes or no.

favorites_only.description: Set to yes to return only the current human user's favorites.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

q.description: Dork/free-text search. Keys: asset,program,name,slug,org,organization,tag,lang,language,platform,mode,bounty,vdp,active,hof,hall_of_fame,reports,reports_24h,reports_7d,reports_30d,reports_month,scope,avg,avg_reward,max,max_reward,min,min_reward,response. Syntax: bare words = free text; key:value filters; multiple terms AND; quote values with spaces (no negation/wildcard operators). Example: platform:hackerone bounty:yes.

reports_24h_gte.description: Minimum reports in the last 24 hours.

reports_7d_gte.description: Minimum reports in the last 7 days.

reports_month_gte.description: Minimum reports in the current month.

response_lte.description: Maximum average first-response time in hours.

status.description: Filter by program status: public or private.

trash_only.description: Set to yes to return only the current human user's trash.

name: list_run_events
description: List a run's Ansible events in counter order (max 100 per page). Requires run_id; use after_counter to page.

after_counter.description: Cursor: return only events with counter greater than this (for paging through a run's event stream).

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 100).

run_id.description: Required. The integer run id whose events to list.

name: list_run_groups
description: List and count Control Center Ansible run groups, newest first. Page with page/limit.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

name: list_scope_runs
description: List bounded Scope collection runs.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

name: list_targets
description: List and count alive targets, optionally filtered by query, program, or status. Use q for dork search (see the q field for keys).

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

q.description: Dork/free-text search. Keys: host,url,ip,port,method,scheme,path,title,webserver,content_type,tech,status,program,tool,page_type. Syntax: bare words = free text; key:value filters; multiple terms AND; quote values with spaces (no negation/wildcard operators). Example: status:200 tech:nginx.

status.description: Filter by HTTP status code, e.g. 200.

name: list_templates
description: List and count Control Center Whiterabbit templates, optionally filtered by kind.

kind.description: Filter by template kind: cmdscript or workflow.

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

name: list_vulnerabilities
description: List and count tracked vulnerabilities, optionally filtered by program, severity, status, or tool. Use q for dork search (see the q field for keys).

limit.description: Max items per page (default and max 50).

q.description: Dork/free-text search. Keys: severity,status,tool,type,program,asset,name,cwe,tag,host,url,ip,port,method,submitted,confidence,date. Syntax: bare words = free text; key:value filters; multiple terms AND; quote values with spaces (no negation/wildcard operators). Example: severity:high status:open.

severity.description: Filter by finding severity (e.g. critical, high, medium, low).

status.description: Filter by report status (e.g. open, triaged, resolved).

tool.description: Filter by the tool that produced the finding.
